design_principles.description: 6-8 board reviews per session instead of 10-26. Merge specialists into a single Quality Board with sub-dimensions.
design_principles.evidence: S724 4-agent board proved effective. S309 demonstrated 43% session reduction by removing artificial dependencies. Agent count is the primary cost driver, not tooling.

design_principles.description: Items are proven structurally and content-ready BEFORE reaching the certification board. A mandatory automated pre-flight scan gate must pass. No item enters board review without pre-flight PASS.
design_principles.evidence: DL-029 demonstrated that prior sessions certified items without verified CorrectChoice alignment. DL-013/DL-026/DL-025 remediation cycles (thousands of fields) occurred because items reached certification with unresolved structural defects. Pre-flight gate prevents rework cycles.

design_principles.description: Only items whose content, dependencies, or governing standards have changed get re-audited. Items with unchanged content hashes inherit prior board PASS decisions without re-review.
design_principles.evidence: S320 showed what v1 cannot handle: the S319 seed inventory's CorrectChoice values were stale — live pack files had rotated CC values. Without delta tracking, stale inventories cause remediation errors. With per-item content hashes, stale inventories are detected before remediation begins.

design_principles.description: Prior board PASS decisions propagate forward automatically. When an item's content hash matches its last-certified hash, the item inherits Certified status without re-entering the board pipeline. Hash-based, not session-based.
design_principles.evidence: S308 HYBRID model required full CAQS §1.6 re-verification for every item in every session. S320 needed a fresh ground-truth audit because prior inventory was stale. Hash-based inheritance eliminates both problems: no re-verification of unchanged items, no stale inventory risk.

design_principles.description: Merge Technical (Accountant), Explanation Quality (EQS/Editor), Difficulty Calibration (DCS/Psychometrician), UI Quality (UIQS), and Learner Safety into one Quality & Certification Board with sub-dimensions. Board members cover dimensions, not separate agents per dimension.
design_principles.evidence: S724's Agent U (Strategic Simulation) showed that parallel specialist tracks add governance overhead without proportional throughput gain. Separate Technical/EQS/DCS agents produced 9-11 reports per session with overlapping findings. A single board with dimension tracking eliminates redundant cross-referencing.

design_principles.description: A mandatory automated scan suite must pass before any human or board review. Scans cover structural defects (DL-008, DL-026, DL-025, DL-016) and content defects (DL-030 CorrectChoice ground-truth, DL-013 boilerplate, EV3 principle citation). PASS = structural clean + CC verified. FAIL = blocked from board. HOLD = correctable by automation.
design_principles.evidence: DL-008 sweeps consumed 3+ sessions to find 539 occurrences — all structural, all machine-detectable. DL-030 found 5 Certified items with wrong answer keys. Pre-flight gate catches both categories before board time is consumed.

states.description: Item has never been audited. No pre-flight scan recorded. No content hash registered.
Item is undergoing automated structural and CorrectChoice scans. No board review has occurred. Transient state — cannot persist as PreFlight.

All pre-flight scans PASS. Content hash registered. Item is staged for Quality & Certification Board review. Delta check shows either: (a) no prior certification, or (b) content hash changed since last certification.
Item is under active Quality & Certification Board review. Sub-dimensions are being scored. Board session is live.
All board sub-dimensions PASS. Content hash locked. Delta baseline established. Item is eligible for learner delivery per CAQS §1.7.1.
Item was previously Certified. Content hash matches last-certified hash. Pre-flight scans re-verified PASS. No board review required — automatic inheritance.
Pre-flight or board review identified defects requiring structural or content revision. Item is NOT ready for certification. Requires author intervention before re-entering PreFlight.
Item removed from active pool. Content preserved. All question_state history retained. May be restored to Unprocessed or PreFlight with documented justification.

Item is quarantined pending investigation (e.g., DL-016 rotation suspicion, CC uncertainty, dependency change). Cannot enter PreFlight or BoardReview while in Hold. Requires explicit governance decision to resolve.
states.learner_pool: EXCLUDED — governance gap fix (GOV-001 from Phase 0B)

transitions.trigger: Session Arbiter initiates pre-flight scan on item(s)
Any pre-flight scan returns FAIL (Critical: DL-008, DL-030) or HOLD after 3 retries
Quality Board Chair opens board session. Item is allocated to board members.

Delta check: item content hash matches last-certified hash AND all pre-flight scans re-verified PASS AND no dependency change AND no governance standard version bump. Automatic inheritance — no board review required.
All board sub-dimensions rated PASS. Board Chair approves certification. Governance Agent verifies governance guard compliance. Release Agent writes certification entry.
Any board sub-dimension rated FAIL. Specific dimension defect logged. Item returned to author for revision.
Item content hash changed (stem revised, CC re-derived, choices modified, EC rewritten). Explicit re-verification request documented. Item must re-enter board pipeline.

Item content hash unchanged but dependency changed (exhibit modified, standard updated). Pre-flight scans must re-verify. Delta check: if pre-flight PASS + dependencies verified → CertifiedDelta (auto-inherit). If pre-flight FAIL → EditorialQueue.
Defects listed in editorial queue entry are resolved. Author submits item for re-scan. Pre-flight entry logged with revision reference.
Explicit archival decision with documented rationale (DL-012 clone redundancy, content consolidation, blueprint re-alignment).
Explicit de-archival decision with documented justification. Item re-enters full pipeline from scratch — no prior certification state preserved.
Governance Agent or Session Arbiter quarantines item due to: unresolved DL-016 rotation classification, CC uncertainty, cross-pack contamination suspected, dependency integrity question.
Governance Agent resolves Hold. Classification documented. Item cleared for pre-flight re-entry.

pre_conditions.condition: Item must have a registered QuestionID in MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY.md. Item must not be in Hold or Archived.
All 8 pre-flight scans (PF-001 through PF-008) must return PASS. No scan may return FAIL. HOLD results must be resolved within 3 retry attempts.

Item must have a prior entry in the certification ledger with question_state: 'Certified'. Content hash (SHA-256 of stem+choices+CC+EC+EW fields) must match the hash stored at last certification. Delta baseline comparison must show NO changes. All 8 pre-flight scans must re-verify PASS on current file state.

All board sub-dimensions (CAQS §1.6 dimensions 1-6 plus G-NEW-1 through G-NEW-5 from QUESTION_METADATA_STANDARD.md §9.4) must be rated PASS by the assigned board member. Board Chair must approve. Governance pre-write check must pass (governance guard all rules). Backup must be created before write per BACKUP_PROTOCOL.md.

Any change to Certified item must be documented in REVISION_HISTORY.md before state transition. Content hash must be recomputed after change. New hash must differ from certified hash — if identical, the item enters CertifiedDelta, not BoardReview.

Hold reason must be documented with specific defect/concern reference (e.g., DL-016 rotation suspected, CC unverified per Phase 0B methodology). Hold must log to DEFECT_LIBRARY.md if defect class is new. Hold must be time-bounded — resolution target date required.

responsibilities: Schedules board sessions with Session Arbiter
Allocates items to board members by dimension
Reviews and harmonizes sub-dimension scores
Makes final PASS/FAIL determination per item
Logs board decisions to Quality Board Decision Record
Escalates unresolved dimension conflicts to Session Arbiter
Ensures CAQS §1.6 six-dimension verification is complete

FINAL on psychometric quality. Must consult EXAM_BLUEPRINT.md and TAXONOMY_REGISTRY.md. Unilateral authority on distractor plausibility.

Board Member B has unilateral authority on blueprint alignment and distractor engineering. Conflicts between members escalate to Session Arbiter for resolution per COLLABORATION_MATRIX.md escalation hierarchy.

merged_from: DL-008 Block-Window Scanner (DL-029 vulnerable — to be replaced)
Governance Guard pre-check (Rule 2 pre-write → Rule 2 pre-board)
v2_board_structure.operations: FULLY AUTOMATED — no human judgment required
dimensions: PF-001: DL-008 — ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice] non-empty (governance guard Rule 2). Must be empty string. Detection method: Function constructor parse with QID→CC→EW[CC] object-path (NOT window scan). CRITICAL.

PF-002: DL-026/DL-025 — Empty ExplanationWrong at non-CorrectChoice positions. Any distractor slot must have >=50 chars of choice-specific text. Detection method: boundary-aware object parse. NON-CRITICAL.

PF-003: DL-013 — Template boilerplate in ExplanationWrong fields. Pattern: 'represents a plausible misconception' OR 'A candidate may select this option by misapplying'. Detection method: regex pattern match per field. NON-CRITICAL.

PF-004: DL-016 — Metadata-block ChoiceA-D vs content-block Choices.A-D divergence (dual-block architecture packs only: A, C, D). Detection method: paired-object parse, cross-reference metadata and content blocks. NON-CRITICAL.

PF-005: DL-030 — Stored CorrectChoice vs independently derived correct answer. Detection method: Item-ledger CorrectChoice extracted from content block, compared against AI-derived answer from stem + choices. CRITICAL.

PF-006: DL-031 — Definition-match difficulty inflation. Stem-CorrectChoice lexical overlap >50% while difficulty labeled >= Moderate. Detection method: Jaccard similarity + difficulty label check. NON-CRITICAL.

PF-007: EV3/EV8 — ExplanationCorrect must reference governing accounting principle by name (ASC, COSO, IAS, IMA standard). ExplanationWrong[CC] must be structurally empty. Detection method: regex for standard citation patterns + DL-008 re-check. NON-CRITICAL.
PF-008: JSON Integrity — Item object must parse cleanly via Function constructor. Detection method: Function('return ' + block)(). CRITICAL.

v2_preflight_gate.description: Mandatory automated scan gate. Must be passed before any item enters BoardReview or receives CertifiedDelta inheritance. Executed by Pre-Flight Scanner agent.

scans.name: DL-008 Structural Check
scans.method: Function constructor parse → extract QID → extract CorrectChoice from same object → check ExplanationWrong[CC] === ''
scans.pass: ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice] is present and === '' for all scanned items
scans.fail: ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice] is non-empty (truthy) for any scanned item
scans.hold: ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice] is absent (undefined) — DL-018 pattern. Resolvable by automation (insert '').

scans.name: DL-026/DL-025 Distractor Empty Check
scans.method: Boundary-aware object parse → for each non-CC slot: check length >= 50 chars
scans.pass: All non-CorrectChoice ExplanationWrong slots have >= 50 chars
scans.fail: Any non-CorrectChoice ExplanationWrong slot is '' (empty) — learner sees no feedback
scans.hold: Non-CC slot present but < 50 chars. Content exists but quality insufficient.

scans.name: DL-013 Boilerplate Check
scans.method: Regex pattern match per ExplanationWrong field: /represents a plausible misconception|A candidate may select this option by misapplying/
scans.fail: Any ExplanationWrong field contains template boilerplate (segment 1 — zero educational value)
scans.hold: Closing-tag only (DL-027 pattern): substantive text + boilerplate closing tag. Removable by automation.

scans.name: DL-016 Metadata-Content Alignment Check
scans.method: For dual-block packs (A, C, D): paired-object parse, compare metadata ChoiceA-D vs content Choices.A-D. For single-block packs (B, E): SKIP.
scans.pass: Metadata ChoiceA-D matches content Choices.A-D for all items, OR pack is single-block architecture
scans.fail: Metadata ChoiceA-D differs from content Choices.A-D. Learner sees wrong explanation text for wrong-answer choices (DL-016 learner-safety risk).
scans.hold: N/A — DL-016 is binary: match or mismatch.

scans.name: DL-030 CorrectChoice Ground-Truth Check
scans.method: Extract stem + choices from content block → independent AI derivation of correct answer → compare to stored CorrectChoice. Per Phase 0B Part C methodology.
scans.pass: Independently derived answer matches stored CorrectChoice (verdict: ALL_AGREE)
scans.fail: Independently derived answer does NOT match stored CorrectChoice. Item has wrong answer key — learner-safety critical defect.
scans.hold: AI derivation confidence < 90%. Requires human or secondary AI verification before classification.

scans.name: DL-031 Difficulty Calibration Check
scans.method: Compute stem-CorrectChoice Jaccard lexical similarity. If >50% overlap AND DifficultyScore >= 3 → flag.
scans.pass: No definition-match inflation detected, OR difficulty recalibration complete
scans.fail: N/A — DL-031 is pedagogical, not safety-critical. Never blocks certification.
scans.hold: Definition-match pattern detected. Difficulty may be inflated. Flagged for board review.

scans.name: EV3/EV8 Explanation Validation
scans.method: EV3: ExplanationCorrect must contain ASC/IAS/COSO/IMA standard reference. EV8: ExplanationWrong[CC] must be empty (redundant with PF-001 but explicit).
scans.pass: ExplanationCorrect contains recognizable standard citation. ExplanationWrong[CC] is empty.
scans.fail: ExplanationCorrect lacks standard citation AND item cognitive level is Apply/Analyze/Evaluate. ExplanationWrong[CC] is non-empty (covered by PF-001 CRITICAL path).
scans.hold: ExplanationCorrect has standard citation but it may be incorrect (DL-009 pattern). Flagged for board review.

scans.name: JSON Structural Integrity
scans.method: Extract QuestionID-bounded block → Function('return ' + block)() → verify parse result has required fields.
scans.pass: All items parse cleanly. All required fields (QuestionID, Stem, Choices, CorrectChoice, ExplanationCorrect) present.
scans.fail: Any item fails to parse. Pack file may have structural corruption (DL-017 pattern: backtick-newline artifact).
scans.hold: Item parses but required fields missing or malformed (DL-024 pattern: missing question_state).

v2_preflight_gate.pass_condition: ALL CRITICAL scans (PF-001, PF-005, PF-008) must return PASS. All NON_CRITICAL scans must return PASS or HOLD. Zero FAIL on any scan. HOLDs on NON_CRITICAL scans are logged but do not block board entry — they are addressed during board review.
v2_preflight_gate.hold_condition: One or more NON_CRITICAL scans return HOLD. Item may proceed to BoardReview with HOLD items logged. HOLDs must be resolved during board review or explicitly deferred. 3 consecutive HOLD results on the same scan → escalate to FAIL.
v2_preflight_gate.fail_condition: Any CRITICAL scan (PF-001, PF-005, PF-008) returns FAIL → item is BLOCKED from BoardReview. Item enters EditorialQueue. Any NON_CRITICAL scan returns FAIL after 3 HOLD retries → item enters EditorialQueue. FAIL items must be remediated by author before re-entering PreFlight.

v2_delta_review.description: Mechanism for tracking content changes and propagating prior certification decisions. Eliminates re-audit of unchanged items.

change_detection.method: Content-addressable hashing. Each item's certification-relevant fields are hashed at certification time and stored in CERTIFICATION_LEDGER.json (new artifact). On subsequent pre-flight, the current hash is compared against the ledger hash.
hash_input_fields: Stem (normalized: trim whitespace, collapse multiple spaces)
Dependencies (exhibit IDs, formula references, standard citations)
change_detection.hash_algorithm: SHA-256 of concatenated normalized field values
change_detection.hash_storage: CERTIFICATION_LEDGER.json — one entry per item: { QuestionID, certified_hash, certified_date, board_session, board_dimension_scores }

change_classification.CONTENT_CHANGED: Hash different from ledger hash. Item requires full PreFlight + BoardReview pipeline.
change_classification.STRUCTURE_ONLY: Hash same as ledger hash but dependency changed (exhibit modified, standard reference updated, governance rule changed). Item requires PreFlight re-scan only (PF-001 through PF-008). If all PASS → CertifiedDelta (auto-inherit).
change_classification.UNCHANGED: Hash matches ledger hash. No dependency changes. All pre-flight scans re-verify PASS. Item inherits CertifiedDelta — no board review required.
change_classification.NEW_ITEM: No ledger entry exists. Item is entering certification for the first time. Full PreFlight + BoardReview pipeline.

inheritance_rules.condition: Item content hash matches last-certified hash in CERTIFICATION_LEDGER.json AND item's ledger state is 'Certified' AND all 8 pre-flight scans re-verify PASS on current file state.
inheritance_rules.action: Item transitions ReadyForBoard → CertifiedDelta. question_state set to 'Certified'. No board review required. Session Pre-Flight Report logs: 'INHERITED — no changes detected.'
inheritance_rules.governance: Governance Agent verifies CertifiedDelta count. Release Agent updates CURRENT_BASELINES.md per-item hash entry. REVISION_HISTORY.md entry: 'Delta inheritance — N items re-certified without board review.'

inheritance_rules.condition: Item content hash matches ledger hash BUT item's dependencies have changed (exhibit modified, formula reference updated, governance standard version bumped) AND all pre-flight scans re-verify PASS.
inheritance_rules.action: Item transitions ReadyForBoard → BoardReview on AFFECTED DIMENSIONS ONLY. If dependency is an exhibit: Board reviews Technical + Numerical dimensions. If dependency is a standard reference: Board reviews Technical dimension only. Unaffected dimensions inherit prior PASS scores.
inheritance_rules.governance: Board reviews only the dimensions impacted by the dependency change. Board Decision Record documents which dimensions were re-reviewed and which were inherited.

inheritance_rules.condition: Item content hash does NOT match ledger hash, OR no ledger entry exists.
inheritance_rules.action: Full PreFlight + BoardReview pipeline. All 6 CAQS dimensions + all G-NEW conditions must be re-verified.
inheritance_rules.governance: Prior certification decision is retired. New certification decision replaces it in CERTIFICATION_LEDGER.json. Item transitions are recorded in REVISION_HISTORY.md.

inheritance_rules.condition: Governance guard rules changed (new rule added, existing rule criteria modified), CAQS standard version bumped, or DCS version bumped, AND item is currently Certified.
inheritance_rules.action: Item transitions Certified → PreFlight. All affected dimensions re-scanned. If pre-flight PASS + hash match → CertifiedDelta (auto-inherit). If pre-flight FAIL on new rule checks → BoardReview on affected dimensions.
inheritance_rules.governance: Session Arbiter triggers bulk re-scan of affected Certified population. CERTIFICATION_LEDGER.json records governance version at certification time. Version mismatch triggers this rule.

inheritance_rules.condition: DL-016 pattern detected: metadata-block ChoiceA-D differs from content-block Choices.A-D. Item is in Certified state.
inheritance_rules.action: Item transitions Certified → Hold. Quarantined from learner pool (GOV-001 fix). Board review required to classify: (a) metadata-only shift (cosmetic, ExplanationWrong fields state but content-block choices are correct), or (b) true answer-key rotation (CorrectChoice itself is wrong). Classification determines BoardReview scope.
inheritance_rules.governance: Governance Agent manages Hold queue. Hold must be time-bounded (resolution target: 2 sessions). DEFECT_LIBRARY.md entry for new DL-016 instances.

reaudit_triggers.priority: IMMEDIATE — item cannot remain Certified with changed content

reaudit_triggers.dimensions_affected: Technical (dim 3), Numerical (dim 6) — if exhibit contains calculation data

reaudit_triggers.trigger: Governance guard new rule or rule change
reaudit_triggers.dimensions_affected: Depends on rule: Rule 2 change → Explanation (dim 7), Rule 4 change → Technical (dim 3)
Explanation (dim 7), Distractor (dim 4) — metadata-content mismatch affects learner feedback
reaudit_triggers.priority: HIGH — learner-safety risk (learners see wrong-topic explanations)

reaudit_triggers.trigger: Content hash collision detected (two different items producing same hash)
reaudit_triggers.priority: CRITICAL — hash algorithm must be verified. Switch to SHA-512 if collisions found.

migration_path.description: Phased migration from v1 (700-series + 800-series HYBRID, 10-26 agents) to v2 (single Quality Board, 7-8 agents, automated pre-flight + delta inheritance).

phase1.name: Infrastructure Foundation

deliverables.detail: New artifact: one entry per item with { QuestionID, certified_hash, certified_date, board_session, board_dimension_scores }. Seed from current 2,182 Certified items. Compute initial SHA-256 hashes.
Current baselines cover 13 runtime files. Extend to include per-item content hashes for all 2,500 items. Re-compute on every certification session.
Replace governance-guard.js Rule 2's DL-029-vulnerable window scan with Function constructor parse. Verify false-positive rate goes to 0%.
deliverables.priority: P0 — current guard is unreliable per Phase 0B

phase1.v1_parallel: 800-series certification continues in parallel during Phase 1. S309's 17-session plan is not interrupted. Pre-flight infrastructure is built while Domain E/F certification proceeds.
phase1.success_criteria: Pre-flight scanner returns verified DL-008 counts (Pack B = 0, Packs A/C/D/E with authoritative counts). CERTIFICATION_LEDGER.json exists with hashes for all 2,500 items. Governance guard Rule 2 uses Function constructor parse. Hold items hard-excluded.

deliverables.detail: Board Member B absorbs Learner Safety Specialist role. G-NEW-1 through G-NEW-5 checks become board sub-dimensions.
700-series is already in Maintenance Mode v1.0 (CLOSED per S723). Formally transfer governance to Governance Agent under Governance & Release Board. Archive 700-series session artifacts.

deliverables.item: Run Domain E/F certification under v2 board structure
deliverables.detail: 167 Domain E + 149 Domain F items certified through v2 Quality Board. Board operates with 3-4 agents instead of 10+. Delta inheritance reduces re-audit of unchanged items to zero.

phase2.v1_parallel: None — v2 board structure replaces v1 after pilot. 800-series HYBRID model is retired. All certification flows through Quality & Certification Board.
phase2.success_criteria: Quality Board processes 12-15 items/session with 3-4 agents (vs. v1's 10-15 agents for same throughput). Delta inheritance achieves <15% re-audit rate on previously Certified items. Domain E/F certification completes at or ahead of S309's 17-session plan.

phase3.name: Full Automation & Modernization

deliverables.detail: Session Arbiter auto-selects ReadyForBoard items. Pre-Flight Scanner runs without manual initiation. Board Chair receives pre-scored item list. Board members auto-assigned by dimension.

Post-certification quality polish: rewrite remaining DL-013 boilerplate fields, normalize ExplanationCorrect structure, fill case-bank EW slots. Run in batches with delta review — changed items re-enter board, unchanged items inherit.
deliverables.priority: P1 — quality polish, deferred from v1

deliverables.detail: Systematic difficulty label recalibration using DL-031 definition-match detection and DL-032 case-bank uniformity analysis. Board Member B manages recalibration as board sub-dimension.
Optimize pipeline to certify an entire domain section (75-100 items) in 1 session: pre-flight takes 20%, board review takes 60%, governance/release takes 20%. Target: 25-30 items/session.

phase3.success_criteria: Portfolio Health Index reaches 82.5+ (B+ grade per S310 projection). All 2,500 items Certified with passing pre-flight scans. Case-bank EW fill rate >= 80%. DL-013 boilerplate eliminated. Difficulty distribution meets CAQS §6.1 targets.

success_metrics_v2.agent_count_range: 6-8 (7 nominal, 8 with optional Editorial Reserve agent for complex sessions)
success_metrics_v2.report_count_range: 3-5 (4 nominal: Pre-Flight Report, Board Decision Record, Governance Verification, Session Closeout; +1 optional Delta Change Ledger)
success_metrics_v2.target_session_duration: 2-3 hours (vs. 4-8 hours observed in v1 S320/S724-style sessions)
success_metrics_v2.reaudit_rate_basis: Percentage of Certified items requiring full BoardReview vs. inheriting CertifiedDelta. Target: >=85% of previously Certified items pass hash-match inheritance (IR-001) and skip board review. Current v1 rate: 100% (every item re-audited every session).
success_metrics_v2.readiness_pass_rate_basis: Percentage of items that pass pre-flight on first attempt (PF-001 through PF-008 all PASS). Current v1 rate: unknown — no pre-flight gate exists. Based on Phase 0B sampling, estimated current pass rate is 60-70% (DL-008, DL-026, DL-016 residual).

additional_metrics.session_overhead_ratio: <30% of session time spent on governance/release (vs. ~40% in v1)
additional_metrics.board_conflict_rate: <10% of items have unresolved board dimension disagreements
additional_metrics.pre_flight_false_positive_rate: <2% (items flagged as FAIL that are actually correct)
additional_metrics.pre_flight_false_negative_rate: <1% (items passed as PASS that have undetected defects)
additional_metrics.delta_inheritance_error_rate: <0.5% (items that inherited CertifiedDelta but should have been re-audited)
additional_metrics.ew_fill_target: >=88% at Phase 3 completion (per S308 HYBRID forecast)

dimensions_compared.v1: Separate Technical, EQS, DCS, UIQS, Learner Safety agents — each producing independent reports with overlapping findings
dimensions_compared.v2: Single Quality & Certification Board — 3 agents with sub-dimensions, harmonized decision record

dimensions_compared.v1: No automated structural gate before board review. Scans run ad-hoc. DL-029 methodology defect (75% false-positive rate on DL-008).
dimensions_compared.v2: Mandatory automated 8-scan pre-flight gate. Function constructor parse eliminates DL-029. PASS required before board entry.

dimensions_compared.v1: No delta tracking. Every item re-audited in every session. Stale inventories caused S320 remediation errors.
dimensions_compared.v2: Content-addressable hashing (SHA-256). Hash-match inheritance: unchanged items skip board review. Dependency-change inheritance: only affected dimensions re-reviewed.

dimensions_compared.v1: Governance guard runs at session boundaries (T0/Tmid/Tend). Governance Agent operates in separate 700-series track (now CLOSED).
dimensions_compared.v2: Governance Agent embedded in session workflow. Pre-write/post-write checks. Governance & Release Board owns backup protocol, registry updates, and defect library entries.

dimensions_compared.v1: 5 states: Unprocessed, In Audit, Editorial Queue, Certified, Archived
dimensions_compared.v2: 9 states: adds PreFlight, ReadyForBoard, BoardReview, CertifiedDelta, Hold. Removes 'In Audit' (replaced by PreFlight→BoardReview pipeline).

dimensions_compared.v1: question_state: 'Certified' is manually set by certification agent. No structural verification gate before state change.
dimensions_compared.v2: Pre-flight PASS → Board PASS → Governance pre-write check → Backup → Write → Governance post-write check → Certification entry. Six-gate pipeline before Certified state is written.

dimensions_compared.v1: Session Arbiter role does not formally exist. Agent allocation is ad-hoc. S320 showed consequences: remediation attempted with stale inventory.
dimensions_compared.v2: Session Arbiter manages item selection, agent allocation, dependency resolution, checkpoint execution. Formal role with defined responsibilities.

dimensions_compared.v1: Hold items (P1-AD-047, AD-048) are served to learners as Tier 2/3 (GOV-001 gap). No formal Hold resolution process.
dimensions_compared.v2: Hold items are hard-excluded from learner pool. Hold state has defined resolution triggers and time-bounded targets. Governance Agent manages Hold queue.

v1_vs_v2_comparison.net_assessment: v2 reduces agent count by 30-73%, reduces report count by 55-64%, eliminates stale-inventory risk via content hashing, adds mandatory structural pre-flight gate, integrates governance into session workflow, and establishes formal session planning. The binding constraint (author capacity for CAQS §1.6 verification and distractor explanation writing) remains unchanged — v2 optimizes everything around it without pretending tools can replace human accounting judgment.
